poses.label: Top
poses.description: Start with feet planted and the bar above your chest in a shoulder-width overhand grip.

poses.label: Lower
poses.description: Lower the bar toward your lower chest, keeping your elbows close to your sides.

poses.label: Chest
poses.description: Briefly touch your lower chest while keeping your shoulders supported.

poses.label: Press
poses.description: Press the bar back up without lifting your shoulders from the bench.

checks: Compared grip, setup, range, and return with the catalog cue and reference.
Validated contacts, framing, and limb lengths across interpolated poses.
limitations: Palm orientation is conveyed by the cue and grip metadata. The renderer does not draw individual finger or wrist orientation.
Phone playback and admin review are pending.
